old_expectation.scope: Initialization container contained seven files and prohibited URLs because no external evidence or public projection had been authorized.

rationale: The added artifact is a later, explicit human publication decision. It preserves the canonical research state, marks full PDRE validation false, keeps the single-deployment boundary, and does not add an evidence source to the original initialization records.
test_disposition: The lifecycle test now checks the original no-URL/no-external-source invariant only across initialization files and separately verifies the publication control's authority and boundaries.
